_about: n-Decane (1) + o-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 20.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n-decane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n-decane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Yang, S.[Shengkai], Wang, Y.[Yujie], Wang, X.[Xuejing], Zhu, Y.[Yong], Chen, N.[Na], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium of binary systems of decane with p-, o-, m-xylene at 20 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 337 (2013) 109-114
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13, 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0026. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.29 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
